ncmake's lint-vue-imports workflow gates exactly this specifier for @nextcloud/vue, so this finding is that red check with a byte figure attached.

1 package is imported by its root in src and offers no module below it in its exports map, so the root is the only specifier there is: luxon (92,485 B in 23 modules). Which of its modules arrive is decided by the package and by tree shaking, not by the import.
